facts.fact: The article reports that in March 2024 MINTTICS held a public consultation on the Livro Branco das TIC 2023-2027, whose proposal set axes including infrastructure and connectivity, regulation, cybersecurity, training and public administration modernisation.
The article gives the White Paper's period as the 2023-2027 quinquennium.

note: The OGE 2025 sector envelope (Kz 226.4bn) is not tied to the policy by the article, so no finance fact.
